messages.content: You are a BPMN 2.0 modelling expert. Produce a complete BPMN 2.0 XML model for the process described by the user. Output ONLY the XML, nothing else.

Each morning, the files which have yet to be processed need to be checked, to make sure they are in order for the court hearing that day. If some files are missing, a search is initiated, otherwise the files can be physically tracked to the intended location. Once all the files are ready, these are handed to the Associate, and meantime the Judgeis Lawlist is distributed to the relevant people. Afterwards, the directions hearings are conducted.

  <process id="CourtPreparationProcess" name="Court Preparation Process" isExecutable="true">
    
    <!-- Start Event: Morning Process Starts -->
    <startEvent id="StartEvent_Morning" name="Morning preparation started">
      <outgoing>Flow_01</outgoing>
    </startEvent>

    <!-- Task: Check Files -->
    <userTask id="Task_CheckFiles" name="Check files to be processed">
      <incoming>Flow_01</incoming>
      <outgoing>Flow_02</outgoing>
    </userTask>

    <!-- Exclusive Gateway: Missing Files? -->
    <exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_MissingFiles" name="Files missing?">
      <incoming>Flow_02</incoming>
      <outgoing>Flow_Missing_Yes</outgoing>
      <outgoing>Flow_Missing_No</outgoing>
    </exclusiveGateway>

    <!-- Task: Search for Missing Files -->
    <userTask id="Task_SearchFiles" name="Initiate search for missing files">
      <incoming>Flow_Missing_Yes</incoming>
      <outgoing>Flow_03</outgoing>
    </userTask>

    <!-- Task: Physically Track Files -->
    <userTask id="Task_TrackFiles" name="Physically track files to intended location">
      <incoming>Flow_Missing_No</incoming>
      <outgoing>Flow_04</outgoing>
    </userTask>

    <!-- Exclusive Gateway: Merge File Preparation Paths -->
    <exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_MergeFiles" name="Files Ready Gateway">
      <incoming>Flow_03</incoming>
      <incoming>Flow_04</incoming>
      <outgoing>Flow_05</outgoing>
    </exclusiveGateway>

    <!-- Parallel Gateway: Fork Parallel Activities -->
    <parallelGateway id="Gateway_ForkParallel" name="Fork Parallel Tasks">
      <incoming>Flow_05</incoming>
      <outgoing>Flow_To_HandOver</outgoing>
      <outgoing>Flow_To_DistributeList</outgoing>
    </parallelGateway>

    <!-- Task: Hand Files to Associate -->
    <userTask id="Task_HandOverFiles" name="Hand files to Associate">
      <incoming>Flow_To_HandOver</incoming>
      <outgoing>Flow_From_HandOver</outgoing>
    </userTask>

    <!-- Task: Distribute Judge's Lawlist -->
    <userTask id="Task_DistributeLawlist" name="Distribute Judge's Lawlist to relevant people">
      <incoming>Flow_To_DistributeList</incoming>
      <outgoing>Flow_From_DistributeList</outgoing>
    </userTask>

    <!-- Parallel Gateway: Join Parallel Activities -->
    <parallelGateway id="Gateway_JoinParallel" name="Join Parallel Tasks">
      <incoming>Flow_From_HandOver</incoming>
      <incoming>Flow_From_DistributeList</incoming>
      <outgoing>Flow_To_ConductHearings</outgoing>
    </parallelGateway>

    <!-- Task: Conduct Directions Hearings -->
    <userTask id="Task_ConductHearings" name="Conduct directions hearings">
      <incoming>Flow_To_ConductHearings</incoming>
      <outgoing>Flow_To_End</outgoing>
    </userTask>

    <!-- End Event -->
    <endEvent id="EndEvent_ProcessCompleted" name="Directions hearings conducted">
      <incoming>Flow_To_End</incoming>
    </endEvent>

    <!-- Sequence Flows -->
    <sequenceFlow id="Flow_01" sourceRef="StartEvent_Morning" targetRef="Task_CheckFiles" />
    <sequenceFlow id="Flow_02" sourceRef="Task_CheckFiles" targetRef="Gateway_MissingFiles" />
    <sequenceFlow id="Flow_Missing_Yes" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_MissingFiles" targetRef="Task_SearchFiles" />
    <sequenceFlow id="Flow_Missing_No" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_MissingFiles" targetRef="Task_TrackFiles" />
    <sequenceFlow id="Flow_03" sourceRef="Task_SearchFiles" targetRef="Gateway_MergeFiles" />
    <sequenceFlow id="Flow_04" sourceRef="Task_TrackFiles" targetRef="Gateway_MergeFiles" />
    <sequenceFlow id="Flow_05" sourceRef="Gateway_MergeFiles" targetRef="Gateway_ForkParallel" />
    <sequenceFlow id="Flow_To_HandOver" sourceRef="Gateway_ForkParallel" targetRef="Task_HandOverFiles" />
    <sequenceFlow id="Flow_To_DistributeList" sourceRef="Gateway_ForkParallel" targetRef="Task_DistributeLawlist" />
    <sequenceFlow id="Flow_From_HandOver" sourceRef="Task_HandOverFiles" targetRef="Gateway_JoinParallel" />
    <sequenceFlow id="Flow_From_DistributeList" sourceRef="Task_DistributeLawlist" targetRef="Gateway_JoinParallel" />
    <sequenceFlow id="Flow_To_ConductHearings" sourceRef="Gateway_JoinParallel" targetRef="Task_ConductHearings" />
    <sequenceFlow id="Flow_To_End" sourceRef="Task_ConductHearings" targetRef="EndEvent_ProcessCompleted" />
